structured_output.content: The release note says only that the `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer` feature was promoted to GA (#7735). It doesn't say what the feature does, what its previous default was, or whether the finalizer name changes for existing resources. The environment shows cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and a cert-manager upgrade from v1.17.0, but the values keys listed (9 of 9) include no feature-gate setting. The CRD dimension is absent, so the installed CRDs list is incomplete. The operator should check the upstream PR #7735 and the v1.18 upgrade notes for finalizer behavior. They should also check any `--feature-gates` flags set outside the supplied values.
